corpus.source: Native high-resolution images and videos with sufficient rights for project testing.
corpus.lock: Create a manifest containing relative path, source SHA-256, license/provenance, scene category, dimensions, frame range, and split. Hash-lock before calibration.

degradation_profiles: known synthetic translation/rotation sequences for temporal ground truth
no_leakage: Do not tune thresholds, branch penalties, operator gains, or coordinate policy on holdout metrics.
After any holdout result is viewed, a subsequent algorithm version must use a newly hash-locked holdout for a fresh claim.
Record every calibration run and configuration hash.
baselines_and_ablations: best single fixed operator from the bank
non-ASH deterministic rule selector over the same bank
ASH state dispatch with branch compiler disabled
ASH state plus branch compiler plus temporal support
blocking_pass: Full spatial ASH vs best fixed operator: Y PSNR paired-delta lower confidence bound > 0.
Full spatial ASH vs non-ASH selector over the same bank: Y PSNR paired-delta lower confidence bound > 0.
Full spatial ASH vs best conventional deterministic baseline: Y PSNR paired-delta lower confidence bound > 0 and MS-SSIM passes the prelocked noninferiority test.
Ringing, alias, severe-regression, and chroma displacement limits pass.
Temporal ASH vs spatial ASH: motion-warped error and flicker improve with positive paired evidence while ghosting and scene-cut limits pass.
failure_behavior: A failed holdout gate is an engine failure, not a documentation issue. Create a new mapping/operator version, preserve the failed evidence, move the exposed holdout to validation, lock a new holdout, and repeat.
non_ash_selector_definition: A deterministic selector over the identical 16-operator bank using the same continuous features but no ASH state bits, codewords, affine recovery, ternary branch messages, or ASH priors. Its rule family and calibration budget must be predeclared and no smaller than the ASH selector budget.
best_fixed_definition: Select one operator ID using development/validation only; apply it to every eligible output cell on holdout. Do not use holdout to choose the fixed operator.
